selectedText: Previous BI had a negative coefficient ($\beta$ = $-$0.00236, SE = 0.00049, $p < 0.001$), but was retained as a baseline control rather than interpreted as a biological response. M16 explained little of the total variation in short-term change (adjusted $R^{2}$ = 0.051). Residuals were approximately normal apart from modest tail deviations, and the lag-1 autocorrelation of normalized residuals was small ($r$ = $-$0.023). The interaction retained the same direction and strong support under lower-bound, midpoint, and upper-bound BI category values. Adding observer as a fixed effect did not improve model fit (likelihood-ratio $p$ = 0.957) or materially change the interaction estimate.
